rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH anatomical_entity_cancer_tissue_diseases AS (
  SELECT
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
    ct.doid AS doid,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    ae.name AS anatomical_name,
    ae.description AS anatomical_description
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
  JOIN disease d ON ct.doid = d.id
  LEFT JOIN anatomical_entity ae ON ct.uberon_anatomical_id = ae.id
),
-- healthy expression joined with anatomy
healthy_expression_by_anatomy AS (
  SELECT
    he.ensembl_gene_id,
    he.uberon_anatomical_id,
    he.uberon_developmental_id,
    he.expression_level_gene_relative,
    he.expression_level_anatomical_relative,
    he.call_quality,
    he.expression_rank_score,
    he.expression_score
  FROM healthy_expression he
),
-- differential expression simplified
differential_expression_rows AS (
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    doid,
    log2fc,
    pvalue,
    adjpvalue,
    statistical_significance,
    expression_change_direction
  FROM differential_expression
)
SELECT DISTINCT gene_symbol
FROM (
  -- genes from differential expression linked to diseases whose name contains 'lung'
  SELECT der.gene_symbol
  FROM differential_expression_rows der
  JOIN disease d ON der.doid = d.id
  WHERE d.name ILIKE '%lung%'
    AND der.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(der.gene_symbol) <> ''

  UNION

  -- genes from healthy expression where the anatomical entity is lung (by anatomical_entity.name)
  SELECT xge.gene_symbol
  FROM healthy_expression_by_anatomy hea
  JOIN anatomical_entity ae ON hea.uberon_anatomical_id = ae.id
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xge ON hea.ensembl_gene_id = xge.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE ae.name ILIKE '%lung%'
    AND xge.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(xge.gene_symbol) <> ''

  UNION

  -- genes from healthy expression where the anatomy is linked via cancer_tissue to a disease with 'lung' in its name
  SELECT xge2.gene_symbol
  FROM healthy_expression_by_anatomy hea2
  JOIN anatomical_entity_cancer_tissue_diseases ctad ON hea2.uberon_anatomical_id = ctad.uberon_anatomical_id
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl xge2 ON hea2.ensembl_gene_id = xge2.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE ctad.disease_name ILIKE '%lung%'
    AND xge2.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(xge2.gene_symbol) <> ''
) t
ORDER BY gene_symbol ASC

rows.question: Show biomarker gene symbol and description for 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description,
    b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_biomarker_id
  FROM biomarker b
),
-- candidate links where biomarker.id matches disease.id (cast to varchar)
-- or biomarker.biomarker_id matches disease.name
biomarker_disease_links AS (
  SELECT
    bc.biomarker_id,
    bc.gene_symbol,
    bc.biomarker_description,
    d.id   AS disease_id,
    d.name AS disease_name,
    CASE
      WHEN bc.biomarker_id IS NOT NULL AND d.id IS NOT NULL AND bc.biomarker_id = CAST(d.id AS varchar) THEN 'id'
      WHEN bc.biomarker_biomarker_id IS NOT NULL AND d.name IS NOT NULL AND bc.biomarker_biomarker_id = d.name THEN 'biomarker_id'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS link_type
  FROM biomarker_core bc
  LEFT JOIN disease d
    ON (bc.biomarker_id = CAST(d.id AS varchar)) OR (bc.biomarker_biomarker_id = d.name)
)
SELECT
  bdl.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  bdl.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core b
LEFT JOIN biomarker_disease_links bdl
  ON bdl.biomarker_id = b.biomarker_id
    AND bdl.disease_name = 'breast cancer'
WHERE
  -- prefer explicit links (by id or biomarker_id name match)
  bdl.disease_id IS NOT NULL
  OR
  -- fallback: include biomarker rows where gene_symbol or description mention 'breast cancer' (case-insensitive)
  b.gene_symbol ILIKE '%breast cancer%'
  OR b.biomarker_description ILIKE '%breast cancer%'
ORDER BY b.gene_symbol NULLS LAST

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_fda_tests_w_drugs_ncit AS (
  SELECT
    bf.id,
    bft.doid
  FROM biomarker_fda bf
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test bft
    ON bft.test_trade_name = bf.test_trade_name
    AND bft.test_submission = bf.test_submission
),
biomarker_with_aliases_and_articles AS (
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.gene_symbol
  FROM biomarker b
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_alias ba
    ON ba.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_article bm
    ON bm.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
),
gene_ensembl_to_uniprot_map AS (
  SELECT
    x.gene_symbol,
    x.ensembl_gene_id
  FROM xref_gene_ensembl x
),
disease_mutation_with_annotations AS (
  SELECT
    dm.id,
    dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
    dm.doid
  FROM disease_mutation dm
),
differential_expression_by_gene_disease AS (
  SELECT
    gene_symbol,
    doid
  FROM differential_expression
),
biomarker_to_disease_links AS (
  -- direct link via biomarker_fda_test.doid
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    bft.doid AS disease_id
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN biomarker_fda_tests_w_drugs_ncit bft
    ON bft.id = b.id
  WHERE bft.doid IS NOT NULL

  UNION

  -- link via differential_expression gene_symbol -> doid
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    de.doid AS disease_id
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN differential_expression_by_gene_disease de
    ON b.gene_symbol = de.gene_symbol

  UNION

  -- link via disease_mutation: biomarker gene_symbol -> ensembl -> disease_mutation.ensembl_transcript_id -> doid
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    dm.doid AS disease_id
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN gene_ensembl_to_uniprot_map gm
    ON b.gene_symbol = gm.gene_symbol
  JOIN disease_mutation_with_annotations dm
    ON gm.ensembl_gene_id = dm.ensembl_transcript_id
),
biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
)
SELECT
  b.gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core b
JOIN biomarker_to_disease_links l
  ON b.id = l.biomarker_id
JOIN disease d
  ON l.disease_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
